notes.title: Mutation: 3 - Update Now Available
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11258508/8a1e4c9b9faf34dbeb6dd9e83f8e6a044f0ee8e4.jpg[/img]
The '[b]Mutation: 3[/b]' update continues to extend end-game content and mysteries for players to discover, coinciding with the [url=https://wiki.gamedetectives.net/index.php?title=Entropy]Entropy ARG[/url].

Get playing - experiment and see what you can find!

Features:
- Added Archive Sanctum - Mysterious alien forces have hijacked the efforts of Entropy and constructed a Sanctum for players to explore, if they can figure out how to access it.
- MKM Console - Updated Commands
- MKM Console - Added Entries

[url=https://www.lordbytesworth.net/blog/onmmutation3]Official Website[/url]
